questions.prompt: Which modifier is placed before an adjective to express 'more' (comparative degree)?
questions.explanation: 'Mas' means 'more' (e.g. Mas malaki = bigger / more big).

questions.prompt: Which prefix is used to form the superlative degree ('the most' / '-est')?
questions.explanation: 'Pinaka-' forms the superlative degree (e.g. Pinakamaganda = most beautiful).

questions.prompt: Which prefix expresses 'very' or 'extremely' when attached to an adjective root (e.g. '___ganda')?
Which prefix expresses equality ('as ... as') when attached to a root word? ______
questions.explanation: 'Kasing-' or 'sing-' expresses equal quality ('as X as').

questions.prompt: Most standard Tagalog descriptive adjectives begin with which common prefix?
questions.explanation: The prefix 'ma-' is attached to roots to form adjectives (ma-ganda, ma-laki, ma-sarap).

questions.prompt: In comparative sentences like 'Mas malaki ang bahay ___ sa kubo', which word introduces 'than'?
questions.explanation: 'Kaysa' or 'kaysa sa' means 'than' in comparative statements.
'Mabagal' means 'slow', which is the antonym of 'mabilis'.
